# dsp::reverb

Module file: `modules/dsp/reverb.mla`

[`dsp::reverb`](DSP-Reverb) provides an allocation-free stereo algorithmic reverb derived
from Martin Eastwood's MVerb topology. The implementation is written in MLang
and retains MVerb's predelay, input diffusion allpasses, stereo early
reflections, cross-coupled late tank, damping filters, and decorrelated output
taps.

MVerb is Copyright (c) 2010 Martin Eastwood and GPLv3-or-later software. This
derived implementation retains attribution and is provided under the same
license terms.

## API

- `Reverb::new(sample_rate_hz: f32) -> Reverb`
- `reset()`
- `process_stereo(left: f32, right: f32) -> StereoFrame`
- `set_damping(value)` — `0` is bright and `1` is dark
- `set_density(value)` — diffusion density
- `set_bandwidth(value)` — input bandwidth
- `set_decay(value)` — late-tail feedback decay
- `set_predelay(value)` — normalized to `0..200 ms`
- `set_size(value)` — room scale; changing it clears delay history
- `set_gain(value)` — output gain
- `set_mix(value)` — `0` dry to `1` wet
- `set_early_mix(value)` — `0` early reflections to `1` late tank

All controls are clamped to `[0, 1]`. Control changes are smoothed per sample;
bandwidth and damping coefficients update at a 1 kHz control rate.

```rust
mod dsp::reverb;

use dsp::reverb::Reverb;
use dsp::reverb::StereoFrame;

var room: Reverb = Reverb::new(48000.0f);
room.set_size(0.75f);
room.set_decay(0.65f);
room.set_damping(0.35f);
room.set_mix(0.30f);

let wet: StereoFrame = room.process_stereo(input_left, input_right);
let output_left: f32 = wet.left();
let output_right: f32 = wet.right();
```

Delay storage is allocated by `new()` according to the sample rate. After
construction, `process_stereo()` performs no allocation, list growth, file
I/O, locking, or logging. Internally it uses the checked
[`std::vec::set_f32()`](Stdlib-Vec) operation to update preallocated circular buffers.

The implementation supports sample rates from 8 kHz through 384 kHz. Use one
mutable `Reverb` instance per independent stereo stream.
